title: cestrum parqui var. poeppigii
intro: Cestrum parqui var. poeppigii, commonly known as the Yellow Jessamine or False Jessamine, is a plant species within the Cestrum genus, characterized by its fragrant and showy yellow flowers. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cestrum parqui var. poeppigii include sedative and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's sedative and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health concerns.
